case.title: MRS. MERCY OBOT v. REGISTERED TRUSTEES OF IKOYI CLUB 1938

procedural_history.originating_proceedings: Claimant filed suit NICN/LA/431/2012 against the defendant. Judgment was delivered on 21st March, 2014 in favour of the claimant.
procedural_history.procedural_posture: Ruling on motion for stay of execution of judgment pending appeal.

previous_decisions.decision: Judgment delivered in favour of the claimant.

interlocutory_applications.application: Motion for stay of execution of judgment pending appeal

appeals.appeal: Appeal filed against the judgment of 21st March, 2014

procedural_events.event: Defendant filed motion for stay of execution.
Ruling delivered granting conditional stay of execution.

material_facts: Judgment was delivered in favour of the claimant on 21st March, 2014.
Defendant filed an appeal against the judgment.
Defendant applied for stay of execution pending appeal.

chronology.event: Judgment delivered in favour of claimant.
Defendant filed motion for stay of execution.
Ruling delivered granting conditional stay of execution.

reliefs_sought.relief: An order staying execution of the judgment of this court delivered on 21st March, 2014 pending the hearing and determination of the Appeal filed against the said judgment.

issues_for_determination.issue: Whether this court should grant a stay of execution in the circumstance of this case.

claimant_arguments: The principles to guide the court in the exercise of its discretion to grant stay of execution have been laid down in a long line of cases.
The courts have unimpeded discretion to grant or refuse a stay, taking into account the competing rights of the parties.
A winning party has a right to the fruits of his judgment.
The applicant must show special and exceptional circumstances.
The facts deposed in paragraph 4 of the affidavit in support can hardly support any special circumstance.
The res here is only a monetary claim; allowing the defendant to retain the judgment debt would give it undue advantage.
The applicant's affidavit falls short of the requirements of law.
The grounds of appeal are frivolous and have not raised any substantial or recondite point of law.
The defendant participated in the whole proceeding and did not protest denial of fair hearing.
Until the National Assembly makes any other law for purpose of appealing the judgment of this court, appeal based on such law shall be by leave of the Court of Appeal.
The balance of convenience is not on the defendant's favour.
defendant_arguments: This court has power to grant stay of execution under Section 47 of the National Industrial Court Act, 2006.
The grant of an order of stay is purely at the discretion of the court.

The applicant needs to show: competent and valid appeal, appeal raises unanswerable question of law, special or exceptional circumstance, inability of the respondent to refund the judgment sum, and balance of convenience in favour of the defendant.
The grounds of appeal are unanswerable in favour of the applicant.
If execution is not stayed, it would be impossible for claimant to refund the judgment sum.
Preservation of the res is to prevent any judgment on appeal from being rendered nugatory.
The balance of convenience is on the applicant.

findings_of_law.issue: Whether to grant stay of execution
findings_of_law.finding: The court has discretion under Section 47 of the National Industrial Court Act, 2006 to grant stay of execution either unconditionally or upon conditions.

judicial_analysis.reasoning: The court considered the guiding principles for stay of execution and the competing interests of the parties. It held that a conditional stay is appropriate, ordering the defendant to deposit the judgment sum in an interest-yielding account.

issue_analysis.issue: Whether this court should grant a stay of execution in the circumstance of this case.

arguments.claimant: The applicant has not shown special or exceptional circumstances; the grounds of appeal are frivolous; balance of convenience not in favour of applicant.
arguments.defendant: The applicant has a valid appeal, special circumstances, inability of respondent to refund, and balance of convenience in its favour.

issue_analysis.judicial_analysis: The court reviewed the principles and authorities. It noted that stay is discretionary and that a conditional stay can be granted to preserve the res.
issue_analysis.holding: A conditional stay of execution is granted.
issue_analysis.ratio_decidendi: A conditional stay of execution may be granted where the applicant deposits the judgment sum in an interest-yielding account to preserve the res pending appeal.

holdings.issue: Whether to grant stay of execution
holdings.result: Defendant ordered to deposit judgment sum in interest-yielding account.

ratio_decidendi.principle: A conditional stay of execution may be granted where the applicant deposits the judgment sum in an interest-yielding account to preserve the res pending appeal.
ratio_decidendi.application: The court applied this principle to grant a conditional stay.

legal_principles.source: Section 47 of the National Industrial Court Act, 2006

legal_principles.principle: A conditional stay may be granted to preserve the res.
legal_principles.source: Okin Biscuits v. Oshe [2001] FWLR (pt. 41) p. 1934

statutory_interpretation.interpretation: The court may order a stay of execution either unconditionally or upon the performance of such conditions as may be imposed in accordance with Rules of Court.
statutory_interpretation.application: The court applied this provision to grant a conditional stay.

precedent_analysis.proposition: Stay of execution will only be granted if there are special or exceptional circumstances.

precedent_analysis.authority: T.S.A (Ind.) Ltd v. Kema Investment Ltd [2006] All FWLR (pt. 300) 1564 at 1576
precedent_analysis.proposition: Arguable grounds of appeal are not a special circumstance for granting stay.

precedent_analysis.authority: Okin Biscuits v. Oshe [2001] FWLR (pt. 41) p. 1934
precedent_analysis.proposition: Payment of judgment debt into an interest-yielding account will meet the justice of the case.
precedent_analysis.reasoning: The court applied this principle to grant a conditional stay.
